name: mesh-gradient-generation
description: Create editable mesh gradients with Figma and SVG workflows
readme: # GenAI Mesh Gradient **A research-informed agent skill for controllable visual generation.** Developed by Yanice Yang, **GenAI Mesh Gradient** helps AI agents translate user intent and design constraints into mesh-gradient visuals for presentations, websites and brands. It combines structured recipes, palette and composition control, editable Figma construction, SVG alternatives and output inspection. **从需求到可修改的渐变图。** 用可复用的 Skill，让 AI Agent 把用途、配色、构图和 反馈变成具体制作步骤。GenAI 负责理解与编排，现有函数负责生成图形和可编辑图层。 下方说明与相关论文的联系，以及当前实现范围。 [English](#english) · [中文](#中文) · [For agents](AGENTS.md) · [Illustrated guide](index.html) ## Samples / 效果样例 Six newly designed native Figma studies, all **1536×1024 (3:2)**, using blue, apricot/orange and warm white. Flower uses magnified cropped planes (56–85% opacity, 125–160 px blur); Heightmap now extracts 40 levels from a warped multi-peak field. Multipoint uses eleven Gaussian-mask groups. The guide also compares the same Sky at 100/150/200 px blur. Images are flattened previews; the native builder and recipes describe their editable construction. 六张均已重新在 Figma 绘制，统一为 **1536×1024（3:2）**，蓝色搭配杏橙和暖白。 本轮重画 Sky 的宽色流、Dreamlike 的错位透光和 Flower 的花瓣局部。Flower 的四个瓣面不透明度为 56–85%，模糊 125–160 px；Heightmap 从多峰高度场提取 40 级等高区域。Multipoint 用十一组宽窄不同的色团形成流向。 图解里另有同一张 Sky 的 100／150／200 px 对照。图片是预览，重建源码和配方 说明如何保留可编辑图层。 | Sky-inspired | Dreamlike | |---|---| | | | | Flower-inspired | Diffuse | | | | | Heightmap | Multipoint | | | | ### How the samples are made / 样例如何制作 | Sample / 效果 | Native construction / 原生做法 | At 1536×1024 / 本图参数 | |---|---|---| | Sky-inspired | Broad diagonal current; 3 curved planes + 2 light fields / 宽幅斜向色流，三条曲线与两个光场 | 125–155 px blur | | Dreamlike | Unequal offset light and shadow; 2 planes + 4 fields / 两个曲面与四个光场，错位安排亮部、阴影和透光区 | 120–165 px blur | | Flower-inspired | Magnified cropped petals; 4 translucent planes + 2 reflections / 放大的花瓣局部，四个半透明瓣面与两处反光 | Plane opacity / 瓣面不透明度 56–85%; blur 125–160 px | | Diffuse | 1 curve + 3 broad radial fields / 一条曲线与三个宽幅径向色场，降低局部对比 | 155–185 px blur | | Heightmap | Warped field with peaks, valleys and saddles; marching-squares contour extraction / 弯曲高度场叠加峰谷与鞍部，再提取等高区域 | 40 levels / 40 级; blur 24–38 px | | Multipoint | 11 Gaussian alpha-mask groups with separate color fills / 十一组高斯透明度遮罩，各有独立颜色层 | No extra blur / 额外 blur 为 0 | [Full recipes and controls / 完整配方与参数](references/figma-recipes.md) · [Rebuild these six studies / 重建六张样例](scripts/blue_orange_studies.js) · [Required native helper / 所需原生辅助函数](scripts/figma_native.js). The builder requires a connected Figma execution tool. Heightmap exposes `detail`, `warp`, `levels`, `blurMin` and `blurMax`; the recipe explains valid ranges. 构建函数需要在已连接的 Figma 执行工具中运行。Heightmap 可分别调整次级起伏、 坐标弯曲、等高层数和模糊值；有效范围与调用示例见配方。 Four browser palette studies share one composition; these are separate from the native studies above. Exact colors, layer order and fade stops are in [palette/layout recipes](references/palettes-and-layout.md). 四张浏览器配色示例使用相同构图；具体颜色、叠层和渐隐参数见配方。 | Monochromatic / 单色层次 | Analogous / 邻近暖色 | |---|---| | ![Warm monochrome](design/illustrations/palette-mono.svg) | ![Adjacent warm](design/illustrations/palette-adjacent.svg) | | Apricot/cobalt / 杏橙钴蓝 | Neutral/accent / 冷中性强调 | | ![Apricot cobalt](design/illustrations/palette-blue-orange.svg) | ![Cool neutral](design/illustrations/palette-neutral.svg) | ## English ### For people #### From generative UI research to a reusable visual-generation skill Developed by **Yanice Yang**, who publishes research as **Liuqingqing Yang**. Her coauthored work examines how generation can respond to user input, design rules and feedback. This project connects that research direction to a concrete design task: helping an AI agent produce and revise mesh-gradient visuals for slides, websites and brands. A request such as “make this softer and leave room for my title” is ambiguous. The skill turns it into explicit choices: a protected text area, color roles, region positions, opacity and edge softness. The agent selects a rendering route, inspects the result and changes the parameter responsible for the mismatch. Its practical contribution is this reusable workflow, together with editable construction recipes and small rendering helpers. | Research connection | How the skill applies the idea | Inspectable implementation | |---|---|---| | User input as a generation condition | Express purpose, palette, reference structure, size and editability in a compact recipe | [Recipe and route selection](SKILL.md) | | Design knowledge as a constraint | Protect content areas; control color roles, composition and scale; distinguish six construction families | [Art direction](references/art-direction.md) and [Figma recipes](references/figma-recipes.md) | | Feedback as part of refinement | Inspect actual output, diagnose a mismatch and adjust one relevant parameter; keep composition fixed for palette comparison | [Refinement workflow](SKILL.md#diagnose-instead-of-adding-more-blur) and [illustrated controls](index.html#direction) | | A usable result beyond a preview | Preserve editable color/mask groups and expose node IDs for later changes | [Native helper](scripts/figma_native.js) and [six-study builder](scripts/blue_orange_studies.js) | **Related research — public author records and papers:** - Yifei Duan, Liuqingqing Yang, Tong Zhang, Zhijun Song and Fenghua Shao. [*Automated UI Interface Generation via Diffusion Models: Enhancing Personalization and Efficiency*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20229) (2025; public preprint submitted March 26). Discusses conditional inputs, design optimization and feedback in UI generation. - Rui Liu, Liuqingqing Yang, Runsheng Zhang and Shixiao Wang. [*Generative Modeling of Human-Computer Interfaces with Diffusion Processes and Conditional Control*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06823) (2026; public preprint submitted January 11). Discusses user intent, context and task constraints in conditional interface generation. These are **connections between research ideas and the design workflow**. This repository implements agent instructions and procedural Figma/SVG helpers; it does not contain the papers' trained diffusion models, weights, training pipeline or experimental reproduction. An external image-generation tool can be selected when a task needs model-generated imagery, with its output labeled as pixels. The paper results do not measure this skill, and coauthorship does not establish sole invention of the papers' methods. Independent adoption and productivity gains have not been established for this package. #### Purpose and practical value Use this skill when a gradient needs to support a real design task: a presentation cover, a readable content-slide background, a website hero, a project thumbnail, or a consistent family of brand/campaign visuals. It helps turn a reference or an open-ended request into decisions an agent can execute: which colors play which roles, where the main masses sit, where text needs space, how edges merge, and what the user should be able to edit later. The intended value is less repeated setup and more consistent revisions; no measured productivity or business-outcome claim is made. | Application | What the skill helps decide | |---|---| | Presentations / PPT | Slide ratio, title-safe space, restrained content backgrounds and export size | | Websites and thumbnails | Desktop/mobile crops, text protection, visual hierarchy and small-size readability | | Brand and campaign systems | Palette roles, recognizable shape grammar and controlled variations across assets | | Reference reconstruction | Native editable color masses, optional separately labeled raster detail, and comparison with the target | #### How to use it 1. Install the complete folder as `genai-mesh-gradient` in your agent's skills directory. Keep the complete folder, including `references/`, `scripts/` and `design/` sample assets. 2. Provide the intended use, dimensions/aspect ratio, a reference or brand colors, the area reserved for content, and the required editability/output format. If you have not chosen colors, ask for a few palette directions at the same composition before making a larger set. 3. For native Figma output, connect a tool that can write to the canvas and give the agent the target file. This skill does not supply a connector or sign in to Figma. The agent must discover the connection's actual capabilities. 4. Review the artwork in its intended application. Refine palette, distribution, fusion and contrast; preserve the selected composition during color comparison. For Codex, a typical installation is: ```sh git clone https://github.com/9929y/genai-mesh-gradient.git \ ~/.codex/skills/genai-mesh-gradient ``` Previously published as **Mesh Gradient Generation** (`mesh-gradient-generation`). For an existing installation, rename its folder to `genai-mesh-gradient`, replace its contents with this revision and update saved prompts. The old invocation is not an alias supplied by this package. Reload your client's skill list if needed. Other agents have their own loading conventions. Installing the files does not itself enable automatic invocation in every client. Example request: > Use $genai-mesh-gradient to create a 16:9 presentation-cover gradient. > Compare monochromatic, analogous and restrained contrasting palettes using > the same composition. Keep the left third quiet for a dark title. After I > choose a direction, build editable layers in my Figma file, inspect the result, > and explain how to change its colors and softness. ### For agents #### Read order and execution Working in the repository: read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), then [SKILL.md](SKILL.md). Invoked through a skill loader: the client normally loads `SKILL.md` directly. `AGENTS.md` is a repository reading/maintenance guide; it does not replace the skill or connect to Figma. Read only what the task needs: | Task | Read next | |---|---| | Choose use case, palette, brand direction or simple editing controls | [Art direction](references/art-direction.md) | | Reuse sample colors, adapt aspect ratio or tune 100–200 px blur | [Palette and layout recipes](references/palettes-and-layout.md) | | Build Sky-inspired, Dreamlike, Flower-inspired, Diffuse, Heightmap or Multipoint artwork; reconstruct a reference | [Figma recipes](references/figma-recipes.md) | | Operate Figma, export SVG, or choose another rendering tool | [Tool adapters](references/adapters.md), plus the installed connector's current instructions | | Explore fluid, pigment, oil/brush or chromatic silhouette rendering | [Related effect recipes](references/effects.md) | | Add ambient motion or source-image reveal | [Motion guidance](references/motion.md) | Inspect the target tool and existing artwork before making changes. Use the helper that fits the task; do not execute every script or load every reference by default. Return the artifact/node link, editable controls, validation evidence and relevant limitations. Repository instructions do not replace the user's choices or provide permission to modify an unrelated file. #### Included tools and boundaries - `scripts/figma_native.js`: `buildMesh(figma, spec)` creates isolated native Gaussian-mask groups with separate color fills and returns their node IDs. Inline it into a supported Figma execution tool; it is not a standalone plugin. - `scripts/render_svg.py`: Python 3 standard-library generator for four original schematic studies. For example: ```sh python3 scripts/render_svg.py --effect atmospheric --seed 17 \ --width 1200 --height 800 --output study.svg ``` - `scripts/blue_orange_studies.js`: rebuilds the six current native studies after `figma_native.js` is inlined. Uses caller-supplied clear x/y; has been executed and visually inspected in live Figma. The compositions use 3:2. Optional `keys` selects individual studies; `heightmap` controls detail, warp, levels and blur. - `scripts/palette_studies.js`: four role-based palette previews and three size-aware layout recipes. `layoutSpec` converts short-side support radii to the native helper's per-axis units. New layout parity with live Figma is unverified. - `index.html`: the single illustrated Chinese guide with real Figma samples, a Sky 100/150/200 px blur comparison, four visible palette examples and recomposed 16:9 / 1:1 / 9:16 studies. Download the **whole repository** and open this file locally; it uses local images/scripts. GitHub's file view displays HTML source. The comparison does not sync edits to Figma. The six recipes include a native builder for the current blue/orange studies; this is a function library for a supported execution tool, not a standalone plugin. The package does not include image segmentation, a shader/reveal engine or automatic PPT creation. Native geometry, imported SVG and flattened bitmaps have different editing limits. For broad light fields, compare 100/150/200 px at a 1536×1024 reference scale. The current Flower planes use 125–160 px blur and 56–85% opacity. Heightmap uses 40 extracted levels with 24–38 px blur and exposes detail/warp/level controls. Scale the selected radius by the short side when resizing the canvas. Recompose for a new aspect ratio. Mask-based masses have no extra blur by default. The legacy SVG `petal` sketch is not a visual target for Flower-inspired artwork. Recipes are grounded in inspected native artwork and recovered historical construction records. The six-study builder and its Gaussian-mask helper have now been executed in live Figma and their actual renders inspected. Browser layout specs still need live-target calibration. Validation details are in the guide. ## 中文 ### 给使用者 #### 从生成式界面研究，连接到大家能复用的视觉生成流程 本项目由 **Yanice Yang** 开发，论文署名为 **Liuqingqing Yang**。 她参与的生成式界面研究关注一个问题：怎样让生成结果回应用户输入、设计规则和反馈。 这份 Skill 把这一研究方向连接到具体制作场景，让 AI Agent 帮助使用者生成和修改 演示文稿、网页及品牌所需的网格渐变图。 例如，“再柔和一点，左边留给标题”还不是工具能直接执行的配方。Agent 需要把它 拆成文字安全区、颜色角色、色区位置、不透明度和边缘柔和程度，再选择工具制作。 看到实际结果后，还要判断改哪个参数。这里的 GenAI 指生成式 AI；在本项目中， AI Agent 负责理解要求、组织制作步骤和调用工具。Skill 是可复用的操作说明与配方， 脚本负责建立图层或生成 SVG。两者一起把笼统的视觉要求变成可以继续修改的作品。 | 研究中的思路 | 在这个 Skill 里怎么使用 | 可以核对的实现 | |---|---|---| | 把用户输入作为生成条件 | 将用途、配色、参考结构、尺寸和可编辑要求写成配方 | [配方与工具选择](SKILL.md) | | 用设计知识约束结果 | 留出内容区域，控制颜色角色、构图和尺寸，区分六种制作结构 | [视觉判断](references/art-direction.md)与 [Figma 配方](references/figma-recipes.md) | | 根据反馈逐步修改 | 回看实际结果，找到主要差异，一次调整相关参数；比较配色时固定构图 | [问题诊断](SKILL.md#diagnose-instead-of-adding-more-blur)与[图解交互](index.html#direction) | | 让产物能被继续使用 | 分开颜色层和遮罩，返回节点 ID，便于后续定点调整 | [原生辅助函数](scripts/figma_native.js)与[六图构建函数](scripts/blue_orange_studies.js) | 相关论文及公开作者记录： - [*Automated UI Interface Generation via Diffusion Models: Enhancing Personalization and Efficiency*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20229)， 2025 年，Duan、Yang 等合著；公开预印本于 3 月 26 日提交。 论文讨论条件输入、设计优化和用户反馈。 - [*Generative Modeling of Human-Computer Interfaces with Diffusion Processes and Conditional Control*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06823)， 2026 年，Liu、Yang 等合著；公开预印本于 1 月 11 日提交。 论文讨论如何把用户意图、上下文和任务限制引入生成过程。 **这里连接的是研究思路与制作流程。** 当前仓库实现了 Agent 指令、Figma 原生构建 函数和 SVG 脚本，没有提供上述论文的扩散模型、训练权重、训练流程或实验复现。 任务需要模型生成的图像时，可以调用外部生图工具，并说明交付的是像素图。 论文中的实验结果不能当成本 Skill 的成绩；合著署名也不能推定为独自发明全部方法。 本项目尚未建立独立采用规模或效率提升的证据。 #### 用途与价值 当你需要给一份 PPT 做封面、给网页留出清楚的标题区域，或者让一组品牌视觉 保持一致时，难点往往不只是“生成一个好看的渐变”。你还需要决定颜色怎么搭、 色块放在哪里、哪些地方应该留白，以及之后怎样方便地修改。 **GenAI Mesh Gradient** 把这些判断整理成 Agent 可以执行的流程：先确定 用途和视觉方向，再选择配色与构图，连接 Figma 或其他合适的工具制作，最后 检查实际效果和可编辑范围。目标是减少重复设置、让修改更一致；目前没有对节省 时间或商业效果做量化验证。 | 使用场景 | 重点解决什么 | |---|---| | PPT 封面、章节页、内容页 | 按原幻灯片比例设计，给标题和图表让出空间，选择合适的导出尺寸 | | 网页主视觉、项目缩略图 | 检查桌面和手机裁切、文字可读性，以及缩小后是否仍有层次 | | 品牌和活动视觉 | 固定颜色角色与形状语言，在多个应用中做有控制的变化 | | 参考图复现 | 分开可编辑色场与可选的位图细节，并用实际导出结果核对差异 | #### 安装与使用 原名为 **Mesh Gradient Generation**（`mesh-gradient-generation`）。已有安装需将 目录改成 `genai-mesh-gradient`、更新为本版内容，再修改保存的调用示例并重新加载。 本包没有实现旧调用名的自动别名。 1. 将整个目录安装为 `genai-mesh-gradient`，保留内部结构。Codex 常用位置 是 `~/.codex/skills/genai-mesh-gradient/`；安装命令见上面的英文部分。 其他 Agent 按各自的 Skill 加载方式使用。 2. 告诉 Agent：用在哪里、画面比例或尺寸、参考图或品牌色、哪里放文字，以及 是否需要可编辑图层。没选好颜色时，可以先比较单色、邻近色、克制撞色等方向。 3. 需要直接在 Figma 制作时，先接通支持画布写入的工具，并提供目标文件。 MCP 在这里负责让 Agent 读取和操作 Figma；安装这份 Skill 本身不会建立连接， 也不会自动登录账号。 4. 将结果放回真实页面或幻灯片里看，再调整配色、分布、融合和对比。比较颜色时 保持构图不变，避免同时改变太多因素。 可以直接这样提需求： > 使用 $genai-mesh-gradient，为 16:9 的演示文稿制作封面渐变。 > 在同一个构图上比较单色、邻近色和克制撞色三种配色，左侧三分之一留给深色标题。 > 等我选定方向后，在我提供的 Figma 文件里建立可编辑图层，回看实际效果， > 并说明我以后如何改色和调整柔和程度。 ### 给 Agent #### 阅读顺序与执行 直接在仓库里工作的 Agent：先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)，再读 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)。通过 Skill 加载器调用时，通常直接加载 `SKILL.md`。 AGENTS.md 负责说明仓库怎么读、怎么维护；SKILL.md 负责执行制作流程。 这两个文件都不会自动连接 Figma。随后按当前任务读取参考： | 当前要做什么 | 读取什么 | |---|---| | 判断用途、选择配色、考虑品牌审美和修改方式 | [art-direction.md](references/art-direction.md) | | 复用配色样例、调整画幅、选择模糊值 | [palettes-and-layout.md](references/palettes-and-layout.md) | | 制作六类 Figma 效果，或复现已有参考 | [figma-recipes.md](references/figma-recipes.md) | | 操作 Figma、导出 SVG、选择其他工具 | [adapters.md](references/adapters.md)，以及当前连接工具的说明 | | 研究流体、颜料、油彩笔触、彩色剪影等相关方向 | [effects.md](references/effects.md) | | 增加缓慢运动或图片显影 | [motion.md](references/motion.md) | 先检查工具能力和目标文件里已有的内容，再动手制作。只读需要的参考、只运行 当前任务用得上的脚本。交付时说明产物位置、可调参数、检查结果和实现限制。 不要因为读到了仓库文件，就推定可以修改用户未指定的其他项目。 #### 已提供什么，还有哪些边界 原生 Figma 函数会建立“独立色团组＋高斯柔化遮罩＋纯色 Fill”，并返回各层的 节点 ID，便于后续定点改色和调整构图。它需要在支持的 Figma 执行工具中调用， 不是双击就能运行的插件。 SVG 脚本使用 Python 3 标准库生成四类原创示意；新增蓝橙六图原生构建函数， 可在支持的 Figma 执行工具中按指定位置重建。它是函数库，不是独立插件。Heightmap 已包含等高线提取，参数说明见配方。本包未实现自动做 PPT、图片分割或完整 动画引擎。原生图层、导入 SVG 和位图的可编辑程度不同，需要分别说明。 图解都在同一份 [index.html](index.html) 中：六类实际 Figma 样例、Sky 三档原生模糊 对照、四张配色示例和比较器，以及 16:9、1:1、9:16 的重排演示。请下载整个 仓库再打开本页，保留图片和脚本目录；GitHub 文件页只显示 HTML 源码。 页面里的修改不会自动同步到 Figma。 宽幅光场可比较 100、150、200 px；本轮 Flower 的瓣面使用 125–160 px 模糊和 56–85% 不透明度； Heightmap 有 40 级等高区域，使用 24–38 px 模糊，并开放起伏、扭曲和层数参数。按短边换算具体值；换比例时重新安排色团和留白。多点遮罩默认不额外模糊。新 `palette_studies.js` 提供 可复用配色与画幅参数；其中布局参数尚未与实时 Figma 渲染校准。旧 SVG 的 `petal` 草图不作为 Flower 效果的视觉参考。 制作方法已结合原生作品结构和恢复的历史操作记录核对。本轮六图构建函数和高斯遮罩函数已在 真实 Figma 中执行并检查了渲染；浏览器画幅参数仍需目标工具校准。验证状态见图解。 ## License / 许可 [MIT](LICENSE). Independent community project; not affiliated with Figma or an image-generation provider. 独立社区项目，与 Figma 或图像生成服务商无隶属关系。
readmeHtml:
GenAI Mesh Gradient

A research-informed agent skill for controllable visual generation.

Developed by Yanice Yang, GenAI Mesh Gradient helps AI agents translate user

intent and design constraints into mesh-gradient visuals for presentations,

websites and brands. It combines structured recipes, palette and composition

control, editable Figma construction, SVG alternatives and output inspection.

从需求到可修改的渐变图。 用可复用的 Skill，让 AI Agent 把用途、配色、构图和

反馈变成具体制作步骤。GenAI 负责理解与编排，现有函数负责生成图形和可编辑图层。

下方说明与相关论文的联系，以及当前实现范围。

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文) · [For agents](AGENTS.md) · [Illustrated guide](index.html)

English

For people

From generative UI research to a reusable visual-generation skill

Developed by Yanice Yang, who publishes research as Liuqingqing Yang.

Her coauthored work examines how generation can respond to user input, design

rules and feedback. This project connects that research direction to a concrete

design task: helping an AI agent produce and revise mesh-gradient visuals for

slides, websites and brands.

A request such as “make this softer and leave room for my title” is ambiguous.

The skill turns it into explicit choices: a protected text area, color roles,

region positions, opacity and edge softness. The agent selects a rendering

route, inspects the result and changes the parameter responsible for the

mismatch. Its practical contribution is this reusable workflow, together with

editable construction recipes and small rendering helpers.

| Research connection | How the skill applies the idea | Inspectable implementation |

|---|---|---|

| User input as a generation condition | Express purpose, palette, reference structure, size and editability in a compact recipe | [Recipe and route selection](SKILL.md) |

| Design knowledge as a constraint | Protect content areas; control color roles, composition and scale; distinguish six construction families | [Art direction](references/art-direction.md) and [Figma recipes](references/figma-recipes.md) |

| Feedback as part of refinement | Inspect actual output, diagnose a mismatch and adjust one relevant parameter; keep composition fixed for palette comparison | [Refinement workflow](SKILL.md#diagnose-instead-of-adding-more-blur) and [illustrated controls](index.html#direction) |

| A usable result beyond a preview | Preserve editable color/mask groups and expose node IDs for later changes | [Native helper](scripts/figma_native.js) and [six-study builder](scripts/blue_orange_studies.js) |

Related research — public author records and papers:

  • Yifei Duan, Liuqingqing Yang, Tong Zhang, Zhijun Song and Fenghua Shao.

*Automated UI Interface Generation via Diffusion Models: Enhancing Personalization and Efficiency*

(2025; public preprint submitted March 26). Discusses conditional inputs,

design optimization and feedback in UI generation.

  • Rui Liu, Liuqingqing Yang, Runsheng Zhang and Shixiao Wang.

*Generative Modeling of Human-Computer Interfaces with Diffusion Processes and Conditional Control*

(2026; public preprint submitted January 11). Discusses user intent, context

and task constraints in conditional interface generation.

These are connections between research ideas and the design workflow.

This repository implements agent instructions and procedural Figma/SVG helpers;

it does not contain the papers' trained diffusion models, weights, training

pipeline or experimental reproduction. An external image-generation tool can

be selected when a task needs model-generated imagery, with its output labeled

as pixels. The paper results do not measure this skill, and coauthorship does

not establish sole invention of the papers' methods. Independent adoption and

productivity gains have not been established for this package.

Purpose and practical value

Use this skill when a gradient needs to support a real design task: a presentation

cover, a readable content-slide background, a website hero, a project thumbnail,

or a consistent family of brand/campaign visuals.

It helps turn a reference or an open-ended request into decisions an agent can

execute: which colors play which roles, where the main masses sit, where text

needs space, how edges merge, and what the user should be able to edit later.

The intended value is less repeated setup and more consistent revisions; no

measured productivity or business-outcome claim is made.

| Application | What the skill helps decide |

|---|---|

| Presentations / PPT | Slide ratio, title-safe space, restrained content backgrounds and export size |

| Websites and thumbnails | Desktop/mobile crops, text protection, visual hierarchy and small-size readability |

| Brand and campaign systems | Palette roles, recognizable shape grammar and controlled variations across assets |

| Reference reconstruction | Native editable color masses, optional separately labeled raster detail, and comparison with the target |

How to use it

1. Install the complete folder as genai-mesh-gradient in your agent's

skills directory. Keep the complete folder, including references/,

scripts/ and design/ sample assets.

2. Provide the intended use, dimensions/aspect ratio, a reference or brand colors,

the area reserved for content, and the required editability/output format.

If you have not chosen colors, ask for a few palette directions at the same

composition before making a larger set.

3. For native Figma output, connect a tool that can write to the canvas and give

the agent the target file. This skill does not supply a connector or sign in

to Figma. The agent must discover the connection's actual capabilities.

4. Review the artwork in its intended application. Refine palette, distribution,

fusion and contrast; preserve the selected composition during color comparison.

For Codex, a typical installation is:


git clone https://github.com/9929y/genai-mesh-gradient.git \

  ~/.codex/skills/genai-mesh-gradient

Previously published as Mesh Gradient Generation (mesh-gradient-generation).

For an existing installation, rename its folder to genai-mesh-gradient, replace

its contents with this revision and update saved prompts. The old invocation is

not an alias supplied by this package.

Reload your client's skill list if needed. Other agents have their own loading

conventions. Installing the files does not itself enable automatic invocation

in every client.

Example request:

> Use $genai-mesh-gradient to create a 16:9 presentation-cover gradient.

> Compare monochromatic, analogous and restrained contrasting palettes using

> the same composition. Keep the left third quiet for a dark title. After I

> choose a direction, build editable layers in my Figma file, inspect the result,

> and explain how to change its colors and softness.

For agents

Read order and execution

Working in the repository: read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), then

[SKILL.md](SKILL.md). Invoked through a skill loader: the client normally loads

SKILL.md directly. AGENTS.md is a repository reading/maintenance guide;

it does not replace the skill or connect to Figma. Read only what the task needs:

| Task | Read next |

|---|---|

| Choose use case, palette, brand direction or simple editing controls | [Art direction](references/art-direction.md) |

| Reuse sample colors, adapt aspect ratio or tune 100–200 px blur | [Palette and layout recipes](references/palettes-and-layout.md) |

| Build Sky-inspired, Dreamlike, Flower-inspired, Diffuse, Heightmap or Multipoint artwork; reconstruct a reference | [Figma recipes](references/figma-recipes.md) |

| Operate Figma, export SVG, or choose another rendering tool | [Tool adapters](references/adapters.md), plus the installed connector's current instructions |

| Explore fluid, pigment, oil/brush or chromatic silhouette rendering | [Related effect recipes](references/effects.md) |

| Add ambient motion or source-image reveal | [Motion guidance](references/motion.md) |

Inspect the target tool and existing artwork before making changes. Use the

helper that fits the task; do not execute every script or load every reference

by default. Return the artifact/node link, editable controls, validation evidence

and relevant limitations. Repository instructions do not replace the user's

choices or provide permission to modify an unrelated file.

Included tools and boundaries

  • scripts/figma_native.js: buildMesh(figma, spec) creates isolated native

Gaussian-mask groups with separate color fills and returns their node IDs.

Inline it into a supported Figma execution tool; it is not a standalone plugin.

  • scripts/render_svg.py: Python 3 standard-library generator for four original

schematic studies. For example:


  python3 scripts/render_svg.py --effect atmospheric --seed 17 \

    --width 1200 --height 800 --output study.svg
  • scripts/blue_orange_studies.js: rebuilds the six current native studies

after figma_native.js is inlined. Uses caller-supplied clear x/y; has been

executed and visually inspected in live Figma. The compositions use 3:2. Optional keys selects individual studies; heightmap controls detail, warp, levels and blur.

  • scripts/palette_studies.js: four role-based palette previews and three

size-aware layout recipes. layoutSpec converts short-side support radii to

the native helper's per-axis units. New layout parity with live Figma is unverified.

  • index.html: the single illustrated Chinese guide with real Figma samples,

a Sky 100/150/200 px blur comparison, four visible palette examples and recomposed

16:9 / 1:1 / 9:16 studies. Download the whole repository and open this file

locally; it uses local images/scripts. GitHub's file view displays HTML source.

The comparison does not sync edits to Figma.

The six recipes include a native builder for the current blue/orange studies;

this is a function library for a supported execution tool, not a standalone plugin. The package does not include image segmentation, a shader/reveal engine

or automatic PPT creation. Native geometry, imported SVG and flattened bitmaps

have different editing limits. For broad light fields, compare 100/150/200 px at a 1536×1024 reference scale.

The current Flower planes use 125–160 px blur and 56–85% opacity. Heightmap uses 40 extracted levels with 24–38 px blur and exposes detail/warp/level controls. Scale

the selected radius by the short side when resizing the canvas.

Recompose for a new aspect ratio. Mask-based masses have no extra blur by default.

The legacy SVG petal sketch is not a visual target for Flower-inspired artwork.

Recipes are grounded in inspected native artwork and recovered historical

construction records. The six-study builder and its Gaussian-mask helper have now been executed

in live Figma and their actual renders inspected. Browser layout specs still

need live-target calibration. Validation details are in the guide.

中文

给使用者

从生成式界面研究，连接到大家能复用的视觉生成流程

本项目由 Yanice Yang 开发，论文署名为 Liuqingqing Yang。

她参与的生成式界面研究关注一个问题：怎样让生成结果回应用户输入、设计规则和反馈。

这份 Skill 把这一研究方向连接到具体制作场景，让 AI Agent 帮助使用者生成和修改

演示文稿、网页及品牌所需的网格渐变图。

例如，“再柔和一点，左边留给标题”还不是工具能直接执行的配方。Agent 需要把它

拆成文字安全区、颜色角色、色区位置、不透明度和边缘柔和程度，再选择工具制作。

看到实际结果后，还要判断改哪个参数。这里的 GenAI 指生成式 AI；在本项目中，

AI Agent 负责理解要求、组织制作步骤和调用工具。Skill 是可复用的操作说明与配方，

脚本负责建立图层或生成 SVG。两者一起把笼统的视觉要求变成可以继续修改的作品。

|---|---|---|

| 用设计知识约束结果 | 留出内容区域，控制颜色角色、构图和尺寸，区分六种制作结构 | [视觉判断](references/art-direction.md)与 [Figma 配方](references/figma-recipes.md) |

相关论文及公开作者记录：

  • *Automated UI Interface Generation via Diffusion Models: Enhancing Personalization and Efficiency*，

2025 年，Duan、Yang 等合著；公开预印本于 3 月 26 日提交。

论文讨论条件输入、设计优化和用户反馈。

  • *Generative Modeling of Human-Computer Interfaces with Diffusion Processes and Conditional Control*，

2026 年，Liu、Yang 等合著；公开预印本于 1 月 11 日提交。

论文讨论如何把用户意图、上下文和任务限制引入生成过程。

这里连接的是研究思路与制作流程。 当前仓库实现了 Agent 指令、Figma 原生构建

函数和 SVG 脚本，没有提供上述论文的扩散模型、训练权重、训练流程或实验复现。

任务需要模型生成的图像时，可以调用外部生图工具，并说明交付的是像素图。

本项目尚未建立独立采用规模或效率提升的证据。

用途与价值

当你需要给一份 PPT 做封面、给网页留出清楚的标题区域，或者让一组品牌视觉

保持一致时，难点往往不只是“生成一个好看的渐变”。你还需要决定颜色怎么搭、

色块放在哪里、哪些地方应该留白，以及之后怎样方便地修改。

GenAI Mesh Gradient 把这些判断整理成 Agent 可以执行的流程：先确定

用途和视觉方向，再选择配色与构图，连接 Figma 或其他合适的工具制作，最后

检查实际效果和可编辑范围。目标是减少重复设置、让修改更一致；目前没有对节省

时间或商业效果做量化验证。

| 使用场景 | 重点解决什么 |

|---|---|

| PPT 封面、章节页、内容页 | 按原幻灯片比例设计，给标题和图表让出空间，选择合适的导出尺寸 |

| 网页主视觉、项目缩略图 | 检查桌面和手机裁切、文字可读性，以及缩小后是否仍有层次 |

| 品牌和活动视觉 | 固定颜色角色与形状语言，在多个应用中做有控制的变化 |

| 参考图复现 | 分开可编辑色场与可选的位图细节，并用实际导出结果核对差异 |

安装与使用

原名为 Mesh Gradient Generation（mesh-gradient-generation）。已有安装需将

目录改成 genai-mesh-gradient、更新为本版内容，再修改保存的调用示例并重新加载。

本包没有实现旧调用名的自动别名。

1. 将整个目录安装为 genai-mesh-gradient，保留内部结构。Codex 常用位置

是 ~/.codex/skills/genai-mesh-gradient/；安装命令见上面的英文部分。

其他 Agent 按各自的 Skill 加载方式使用。

2. 告诉 Agent：用在哪里、画面比例或尺寸、参考图或品牌色、哪里放文字，以及

是否需要可编辑图层。没选好颜色时，可以先比较单色、邻近色、克制撞色等方向。

3. 需要直接在 Figma 制作时，先接通支持画布写入的工具，并提供目标文件。

MCP 在这里负责让 Agent 读取和操作 Figma；安装这份 Skill 本身不会建立连接，

也不会自动登录账号。

4. 将结果放回真实页面或幻灯片里看，再调整配色、分布、融合和对比。比较颜色时

保持构图不变，避免同时改变太多因素。

可以直接这样提需求：

> 使用 $genai-mesh-gradient，为 16:9 的演示文稿制作封面渐变。

> 在同一个构图上比较单色、邻近色和克制撞色三种配色，左侧三分之一留给深色标题。

> 等我选定方向后，在我提供的 Figma 文件里建立可编辑图层，回看实际效果，

> 并说明我以后如何改色和调整柔和程度。

A research-informed agent skill for controllable visual generation, developed
by Yanice Yang (research publications: Liuqingqing Yang). The workflow connects
user input, explicit design constraints and feedback to editable visual output.
Read the bilingual README for the two related papers and the precise connection.
This package supplies agent instructions and procedural renderers; it does not
implement or reproduce the papers' trained diffusion models. Do not present
their reported metrics as results for this skill or infer sole invention from
coauthorship. Use an external image-generation tool only when the task calls for
model-generated pixels and label that output accurately.

Turn a visual reference into an explicit recipe, render it in a suitable tool,
inspect the result, and adjust the parameter responsible for the mismatch.
Prefer an editable construction when the user needs to keep designing.

This skill supplies design decisions and small rendering helpers. It does not
install an app, establish a Figma connection, or grant file permissions.

## Start with the actual request

Identify the reference or palette, intended use, dimensions, transparency,
editability, and whether the user wants a still, ambient motion, or image reveal.
Use provided context; ask only when a missing choice changes the outcome.
If dimensions are unspecified, use a 1200 × 800 landscape study and say so.

Read [art-direction.md](references/art-direction.md) for the intended use,
palette selection, brand judgment and an editing process a non-specialist can
follow. For a deck, design in its actual slide ratio with a quiet text zone.
For a website, check mobile crop and text protection. Do not deliver an artwork
that only looks good without its real foreground content.

When color is undecided, offer a small comparison: monochromatic, analogous,
and a restrained contrasting accent (or neutral-plus-accent for dense content).
Use the same geometry and seed so the user is choosing color, not different
compositions. Explain roles, a fitting use and a tradeoff; lock the selected
palette before making a large batch. Do not overwrite supplied brand colors.

Distinguish three tasks:

- **Reconstruct:** preserve the reference's composition, color proportions,
  bright and dark masses, direction, and edge behavior. Do not replace these
  with a random attractive palette.
- **Generate:** design a new composition from the requested palette and mood.
  Label it as an original study rather than an exact recreation.
- **Image-derived abstraction:** extract color, connected regions, approximate
  coverage, position, luminance, and major structure before choosing a renderer.

## Choose a route by capability

Read [adapters.md](references/adapters.md) for the selected tool only.

| Need | Route | What stays editable |
|---|---|---|
| Figma still, color masses, soft topology | Native radial fills and optional vector shapes | Shape, fill, stop alpha, position, scale, stacking |
| Portable still without a write connection | Layered SVG | Paths and gradient definitions in an SVG editor; import fidelity must be checked |
| Warped flow, diffusion, paint simulation, continuous reveal | Canvas/WebGL or a tool with documented shader support | Parameters/code; an exported bitmap is flattened |
| Model-generated material or complex illustration | Available image-generation tool | Usually pixels; never describe it as editable mesh geometry |

Discover the actual connector tools before promising an action. A connection
with only read tools cannot create native Figma layers. If a Figma write tool
exists, use its current instructions and required session flow. Otherwise offer
SVG or a runnable renderer, or explain the one missing connection. Do not
silently substitute a bitmap for requested editable layers.

## Write a compact recipe before rendering

Use normalized coordinates with the origin at the top left. Specify:

```text
effect: sky-inspired | dreamlike | flower-inspired | diffuse | heightmap | multipoint
optional browser study: atmospheric | fluid | pigment | oil | silhouette | petal
canvas: width, height, opaque base or transparent
palette: ordered colors with intended roles and rough area proportions
regions: color, center(x,y), extent(rx,ry), direction, opacity, edge softness
structure: bright/dark masses, silhouette or petal boundary if required
material: grain scale/amount, optional warp, pooling or brush hierarchy
seed: fixed for reproducible comparisons
delivery: native Figma | layered SVG | rendered image | executable code
```

Several disconnected regions may share one color. One average position per
color loses a composition with the same hue in opposite corners.
Region radii and alpha are not area coverage: overlap and stacking change the
visible proportions. Inspect the composite before claiming a palette match.

## Build the still first

For the Figma workflow, read [figma-recipes.md](references/figma-recipes.md):
Sky-inspired, Dreamlike, Flower-inspired, Diffuse, Heightmap, and Multipoint.
For matching an existing bitmap, also read the fitting and detail-calibration
procedure there. These are distinct construction choices, not six filters.

Read [effects.md](references/effects.md) only for the related browser-rendering
families (atmospheric, fluid, pigment, brush, silhouette and petal). Keep each
visual grammar separate from presets such as pale, dark, or saturated. A
fidelity level is a mode of an effect, not a new effect family.

1. Block the base and major color masses. Match composition and light/dark
   balance before adding texture.
2. Adjust overlap, asymmetry, edge softness, and local contrast. A few strong
   masses often work better than many weak ones.
3. Add only the material cues that distinguish the requested family. Keep
   fine grain separate from low-frequency boundary distortion.
4. Render at the intended dimensions. Inspect both the whole image and a
   detail crop at normal display scale.
5. Fix the dominant mismatch, keeping seed and unrelated parameters fixed.
   Stop when the reference/use-case criteria pass.

## Simplify the user's edits

Expose a few meaningful choices first: use-case/quiet zone, palette, composition,
fusion/softness and contrast. Keep per-layer controls available for refinement.
Return `massNodes` from the native helper so later edits can target each group's
transform and its separate color fill without changing the mask.

For size, aspect ratio, palette sample recipes and blur, read
[palettes-and-layout.md](references/palettes-and-layout.md). At a 1536×1024
reference size, compare **100 / 150 / 200 px** for broad light fields. The current soft
Flower uses **125–160 px** and **56–85% plane opacity**; the 40-level Heightmap uses **24–38 px**;
scale a chosen radius by min(width,height)/1024 when resizing the canvas.
Changing export scale alone does not require changing the layer radius again.
Tune sample-specific values for edge fusion and contour identity; use broader diffusion only when it serves the composition;
judge each layer rather than imposing one number. The Gaussian-mask method has
no extra layer blur by default. For a different aspect ratio, recompose the
centers and quiet zone, and define physical mass radii relative to the short
side; do not nonuniformly stretch or assume a centered crop will work.

Use `scripts/palette_studies.js` for the exact four-pool browser palette examples
and three recomposed Gaussian-mask layout specs. These are original sample
recipes, not automatic replicas of the six Figma studies. Inspect a selected
sample in `design/illustrations/` when matching its appearance; a method label
alone is not enough. The old radial `petal` SVG sketch is not the Flower target.

For normal recoloring, edit the named color fills, preserve geometry, then
inspect the composite. For layout, move/scale/rotate a whole mass group.
Keep raster corrections off during substantial redesign.

The current blue/orange gallery can be reconstructed with
`scripts/blue_orange_studies.js`, inlined after `figma_native.js`; read the
current construction table in `figma-recipes.md`. This six-study builder has
been executed in live Figma and returns native artboard/layer IDs. Its paths
use a 3:2 composition; recompose before adapting to a different ratio.

Helpers:

- `scripts/figma_native.js` defines `buildMesh(figma, spec)` for native Gaussian
  alpha-mask groups with separate solid color fills. Read the adapter first.
  It deliberately creates no texture,
  segmentation, mesh control-point grid, or animation.
- `python3 scripts/render_svg.py --effect atmospheric --output study.svg`
  creates an original deterministic SVG study. Run `--help` for dimensions,
  seed, palette and texture options. It provides four schematic families;
  it does not analyze an input image or reproduce all six advanced effects.

## Diagnose instead of adding more blur

| Symptom | Likely cause | First correction |
|---|---|---|
| Defocused photograph | Renderer still depends on fine source pixels | Rebuild from simplified regions; discard fine texture |
| Muddy/gray mixture | Too much overlapping complementary pigment | Separate major masses; reduce broad alpha; restore a light or dark anchor |
| Visible colored circles | Similar circular masses and isolated boundaries | Vary aspect/placement; overlap; use shaped vectors where contours matter |
| Horizontal sunset bands | Centers aligned on rows | Change topology and direction, not just hue |
| Texture covers everything | Grain too large or opaque | Lower amount; inspect at actual display size |
| Petal looks like a flower icon | Perfect radial symmetry, central rosette | Enlarge/crop planes; use a curved shadow and transmitted light if the reference calls for it |
| Dreamlike looks ornamental | Thin closed highlight loop replaces broad light | Remove the outline and restore unequal offset light/shadow regions |
| Heightmap stays simple despite many layers | Repeated scaled outline, no saddles | Change the height field and inspect splits/merges before increasing levels |
| Export differs from preview | Different dimensions, color/filter handling or pipeline | Render both through the same pipeline; check actual exported pixels |

## Add motion only when requested

Read [motion.md](references/motion.md). Keep the still's settings independent
from reveal progress and ambient time. Do not assume every effect should end
at a photograph: use the user's requested endpoint.

## Deliver with evidence

Return the usable artifact or Figma node link, route, effect and key adjustable
parameters. State what is editable and which effects were approximated or
rasterized. Confirm export dimensions, background/alpha and orientation.
For a reference match, discuss composition/coverage/edges rather than claiming
pixel identity without an image comparison.

Keep original references unchanged. Do not publish private file links, local
paths, personal conversation transcripts, or third-party reference images as
part of a reusable recipe. Use original examples or licensed assets.

## Scope of evidence

The Figma recipes are grounded in read-only inspection of existing native
artwork and recovered historical construction records. The original chat UI
could not be restored. Node structures and representative renders were checked;
design intent and undocumented algorithms are identified as interpretations.
Browser effect and motion guidance additionally synthesizes archived prototype
notes. Parameter ranges are starting points. See `index.html` for validation
status. Neither raw history nor private Figma file links are bundled.
